item.title: Niigata Sake: Japan's Highest Density of Breweries — Guide
item.description: Niigata has the highest concentration of sake breweries per capita of any prefecture in Japan, a heritage built on the combination of severely cold winters, exceptionally pure snowmelt water, and access to premium local rice varieties like koshihikari. The region’s sake is generally characterised by a crisp, dry, clean-tasting style known as ‘tanrei karakuchi,’ distinct from the sweeter styles found elsewhere in Japan, and each March the massive Sake no Jin festival gathers dozens of breweries under one roof for one of the country’s largest sake tasting events.
